entries.name: Uc
entries.greeting: Lay your belt and boots on the bench. No Guild stamp, no ledger fee—only honest needlework.

entries.name: Clerk Anselm
entries.greeting: If I write it on loose paper instead of the bound volume, the Scriptorium sees nothing—and you know what you carry.

entries.name: Tibors
entries.greeting: Keep your lantern low by the lime-vats. The Eight Chains follow anyone walking upright under a painted lintel.

entries.name: Peyre
entries.greeting: Brass weights mean one thing at Prosay's door and another by the slag-chute. Trade what you will not carry past Mars.

entries.name: Mirande
entries.greeting: The ink in the margins is louder than the text. Let me read your phials and scrolls before you test them.

entries.name: Orable
entries.greeting: Speak plainly—are you turning back toward the Return, or cutting loose along the Serpent's seam?

entries.name: Hesper
entries.greeting: Even beneath the avenue a blade ought to carry an honest edge. Keep step cleanly and I will oil your guard.

entries.name: Brother Calix
entries.greeting: Sit by the shuttered oil-lamp. We still sing without the brass wheel, and we still bind burns.

entries.name: Wren
entries.greeting: Some say hide in the limestone forever; I say walk clean to the seventh sill and let them see the door open.

entries.name: Almoner Dessa
entries.greeting: No ration ticket needed down here. Drink while the pot stays hot, and spare your blood for deeper stairs.

entries.name: Ferrant
entries.greeting: A binding can cut either way. Give me a knotted hilt or cursed iron and I will strip its stamp clean.

entries.name: Odo
entries.greeting: The night-cart rolls only while the lamps stay shuttered. Swap spare iron or vials before I pull out.

entries.name: Sister Vesper
entries.greeting: We stopped the false-sun chime at dusk. Leave the weight on the sill and let your armor rest uncursed.

entries.name: Tallyman Corvin
entries.greeting: A seal can hold a gate open as easily as shut. Hold an oath below, and I can shave one notch off its tally.

entries.name: Keeper Sable
entries.greeting: Everything dropped through the grates washes into the cold catch-basins sooner or later.

entries.name: Precentor Jule
entries.greeting: Burn every choir sheet—then decide which Way you mean to stand on when the Sentinel breaks.

entries.name: Brother Bram
entries.greeting: Measure twice, sign once. If you bear a divine contract, I know how to steady your pace without breaking form.

entries.name: Warden Tomas
entries.greeting: Forty years locking iron doors down here teaches you how to slip a chain before the Sentinel hears the bolt.
